_what: What a reviewer is told in place of a diff too large to inline: that the change was not withheld, which files were excluded and why, the exact command to read any file, and that an unread file may not be assumed clean.
_why: These sentences were written in team-lead-review.sh and substituted into __STORY_DIFF__ — model-facing instruction in a shell script, unreviewable in the prompt layer and unchangeable per project. The detector found it as an unexplained multi-line quoted string. Only the words live here; the byte count, the codeline root and the base revision are facts and arrive as values.
_bodies: excluded — generated files were filtered out of the stat, so the reviewer must be told they are gated elsewhere rather than left to wonder. plain — nothing was filtered.

bodies.excluded:
[The change is __DIFF_BYTES__ bytes and is NOT inlined here. Generated files (lockfiles, snapshots) are excluded above and gated separately -- they are not review material. Read what you need:

    git -C __PROJECT_ROOT__ diff __REV_BASE__ HEAD -- <path>

Review every file listed. Do not assume a file you did not read is defect-free.]
